notes.title: "I don't know why it's so addictive…" – RangerArea on Blitzkrieg Express
notes.content:
"I’ve been sitting here playing this mess for 40 minutes — I need to stop… Okay, one more round," — there’s nothing we love more than sincere feedback 😅
Big thanks to Pascal for this awesome review. And it looks like Blitzkrieg Express is slowly earning its place as the weirdest tower defense game out there!

Check out RangerArea’s video and let him know in the comments if you agree or not 🚂
[previewyoutube="QqYUDcZt-vI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Play Blitzkrieg Express in your language!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596874/8dddb585870a52e083fca54b631eed9775636d8d.png"]With Update 1.0.8, we’ve added localization in 6 more languages to help new players jump in and enjoy the ride.
You can switch the language anytime in the in-game Settings. 

Check out the full list:

🇩🇪 German 

🇫🇷 French 

🇮🇹 Italian 

🇨🇳 Chinese 

🇺🇦 Ukrainian 

🇵🇹 Portuguese
We also added some minor bug fixes, including the achievements issue. 
Found a translation bug or awkward phrasing? Let us know! Your feedback helps us improve the experience for everyone.

notes.title: "It’s dumb, but that’s what makes it fun" – an honest video review
notes.content:
We’ve been spotted! Maxim made a whole video about our game and called Blitzkrieg Express “the weirdest tower defense game of all time.”
That’s one of the best pieces of feedback we’ve ever received 😄 

If you’ve got a few minutes, check out his video and leave a comment to let him know what you think 💭
[previewyoutube="FojuEIX-OQM;full"][/previewyoutube]
